loadedArtifacts.confidenceNotes: Official county detailxml.zip reports from the Iowa Secretary of State Clarity results app. The parser loads county certified presidential totals, precinct President-versus-U.S. House review rows, and VoterTurnout precinct ballotsCast/totalVoters rows. U.S. House remains district-based advisory comparison context.

sourceFindings.parserOrNormalizationPath: not currently normalized into the public vote-method CSV/API contract
sourceFindings.evidence: Sample county detail XML includes Choice/VoteType rows for President with Election Day and Absentee precinct votes, plus VoterTurnout precinct ballotsCast and totalVoters fields.
sourceFindings.caveats: The current public vote-method loader reads normalized CSVs under data/eac-2024-vote-methods. Iowa Clarity VoteType rows are candidate/contest votes by method, not all-ballot turnout by method, so a dedicated normalizer and UI caveat are needed before publication.

sourceFindings.caveats: The current package contains county geometry only. Scripted access to the SOS auditors page returned a Cloudflare browser challenge from this environment on July 1, 2026; use browser/manual follow-up or county auditor requests for statewide precinct boundary GIS or a reporting-unit crosswalk.

sourceFindings.sourceAuthority: Iowa General Assembly; Iowa Secretary of State and county commissioners
sourceFindings.caveats: Iowa Code section 50.51 establishes election audits and county audit reports to the state commissioner, but this pass did not identify or normalize 2024 selected-precinct audit reports or outcomes. Request the 2024 county audit reports and any statewide selection list before loading audit context.
